title: Synthetic Semantic Dynamics Under Brand Coherence Field Theory: A Simulation-Based Technical Report
description: Computational companion to Brand Coherence Field Theory (BCFT). BCFT models brand meaning as a family of probability distributions over a semantic space and defines coherence as (negative) divergence from an ideal brand distribution on a statistical manifold. This deposit contains the formal apparatus and executed experiments: real divergences (Kullback-Leibler, Jensen-Shannon), Fisher-Rao geodesics, and natural-gradient coherence flows on the probability simplex, a fully reproducible Python pipeline (fixed seed), a synthetic brand-field dataset, generated figures, and the compiled technical report (PDF).
